claim: Heritable fragile bone disorders (FBDs) are characterized by an elevated fracture risk.
source: Heritable fragile bone disorders (FBDs), ranging from multifactorial to rare monogenic conditions, are characterized by an elevated fracture risk.
evidence: This is a definitional statement about FBDs presented in the abstract.

claim: Six genes linked to severe recessive osteogenesis imperfecta (OI) were analyzed in this study.
source: Six genes linked to severe recessive osteogenesis imperfecta (OI) and four associated with bone mineral density (BMD) from genome-wide association studies were analyzed.
evidence: The abstract explicitly states the number and type of genes analyzed.

claim: Four genes associated with bone mineral density (BMD) from genome-wide association studies were analyzed in this study.
source: Six genes linked to severe recessive osteogenesis imperfecta (OI) and four associated with bone mineral density (BMD) from genome-wide association studies were analyzed.
evidence: The abstract explicitly states the number and type of genes analyzed.

claim: CRISPR/Cas9-based crispant screening in F0 mosaic founder zebrafish achieved a mean indel efficiency of 88%.
source: Using CRISPR/Cas9-based crispant screening in F0 mosaic founder zebrafish, Next-generation sequencing confirmed high indel efficiency (mean 88%), mimicking stable knock-out models.
evidence: NGS data confirmed the indel efficiency across the crispants studied.

claim: Skeletal phenotyping was performed at 7, 14, and 90 days post-fertilization (dpf).
source: Skeletal phenotyping at 7, 14, and 90 days post-fertilization (dpf) using microscopy, Alizarin Red S staining, and microCT was performed.
evidence: The abstract describes the experimental timeline for phenotyping.

claim: Adult crispants displayed consistent skeletal defects, including malformed neural and haemal arches, vertebral fractures and fusions, and altered bone volume and density.
source: Larval crispants showed variable osteoblast and mineralization phenotypes, while adult crispants displayed consistent skeletal defects, including malformed neural and haemal arches, vertebral fractures and fusions, and altered bone volume and density.
evidence: The abstract summarizes the phenotypic findings in adult crispants.

claim: aldh7a1 and mbtps2 crispants experienced increased mortality due to severe skeletal deformities.
source: In addition, aldh7a1 and mbtps2 crispants experienced increased mortality due to severe skeletal deformities.
evidence: The abstract explicitly states the mortality outcome for these specific crispants.

claim: RT-qPCR revealed differential expression of osteogenic markers bglap and col1a1a.
source: RT-qPCR revealed differential expression of osteogenic markers bglap and col1a1a, highlighting their biomarker potential.
evidence: The abstract reports the molecular findings from RT-qPCR analysis.

claim: Osteoporosis affects about 200 million people around the world.
source: It affects about 200 million people around the world (Pouresmaeili et al., 2018).
evidence: This is a cited epidemiological statistic.

claim: In Europe, 5.6% of the population aged over 50 is diagnosed with osteoporosis.
source: In Europe, 5.6% of the population aged over 50 is diagnosed with osteoporosis, making it a highly prevalent disease, especially in the elderly.
evidence: This is an epidemiological statistic about osteoporosis prevalence in Europe.

claim: Low BMD and fractures are highly heritable risk factors, with heritability values ranging from 50% to 80%.
source: Low BMD and fractures are highly heritable risk factors, with heritability values ranging from 50% to 80% (Richards et al., 2012).
evidence: This is a cited statement about the heritability of bone-related traits.

claim: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) in humans have unraveled hundreds of susceptible loci associated with BMD and other bone traits related to risk of osteoporotic fracture.
source: Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) in humans have unraveled hundreds of susceptible loci associated with BMD and other bone traits related to risk of osteoporotic fracture (Zhu et al., 2021).
evidence: This is a cited statement about GWAS findings.

claim: More than 70% of human protein-coding genes have zebrafish orthologs.
source: More than 70% of human protein-coding genes and 82% of human disease-related genes have zebrafish orthologs, including most of the genes involved in skeletogenesis (Howe et al., 2013).
evidence: This is a cited statement about genetic conservation between humans and zebrafish.

claim: 82% of human disease-related genes have zebrafish orthologs.
source: More than 70% of human protein-coding genes and 82% of human disease-related genes have zebrafish orthologs, including most of the genes involved in skeletogenesis (Howe et al., 2013).
evidence: This is a cited statement about genetic conservation between humans and zebrafish.

claim: Zebrafish share many of their skeletal features and ossification mechanisms with mammals.
source: Additionally, zebrafish share many of their skeletal features and ossification mechanisms with mammals (Dietrich et al., 2021) and numerous zebrafish models for skeletal diseases have been established and investigated (Gistelinck et al., 2018; Daponte et al., 2023; Kague and Karasik, 2022).
evidence: This is a cited statement about skeletal similarities between zebrafish and mammals.

claim: Adult crispants have a shorter generation time (~3 months) than stable lines (6–9 months).
source: Adult crispants have a shorter generation time (~3 months) than stable lines (6–9 months), which allows screening more genes in less time and at lower costs and resources.
evidence: This is a comparison of generation times between crispants and stable lines.

claim: The phenotypes and molecular profiles of a stable knockout line and a crispant for the osteoporosis gene lrp5 were found to be highly similar.
source: We previously demonstrated the feasibility of this approach by comparing the phenotypes and molecular profiles of a stable knockout line and a crispant for the osteoporosis gene lrp5, and found them to be highly similar (Bek et al., 2020).
evidence: This is a cited finding from a previous study by the authors.

claim: Comparison of crispants to homozygous germline mutants for bmp1a and plod2 revealed phenotypic convergence.
source: In a study by Watson et al., 2020, comparison of crispants to homozygous germline mutants for bmp1a and plod2, two causal OI genes, revealed phenotypic convergence, suggesting that crispants faithfully recapitulate the biology of germline skeletal disease models.
evidence: This is a cited finding from Watson et al., 2020.

claim: ALDH7A1, ESR1, DAAM2, and SOST were selected as top candidate genes with single zebrafish orthologs associated with bone density.
source: We then identified the genes that harbored these variants and chose the top four candidates with single zebrafish orthologs: ALDH7A1, ESR1, DAAM2, and SOST.
evidence: The text describes the gene selection process for osteoporosis-related genes.

claim: Six genes associated with recessive forms of OI were selected: CREB3L1, MBTPS2, SPARC, SERPINF1, IFITM5, and SEC24D.
source: Furthermore, we selected six genes associated with recessive forms of OI associated with severe skeletal phenotypes, and involved in different aspects of bone formation, including osteoblast differentiation (CREB3L1, MBTPS2, and SPARC), bone mineralization (SERPINF1 and IFITM5) and collagen transport (SEC24D).
evidence: The text explicitly lists the OI genes selected for the study.

claim: The minimal indel efficiency across the different crispants was 71%.
source: Across the different crispants the minimal indel efficiency was 71%, while the OOF rate ranged between 49 and 73%.
evidence: This is a quantitative result from NGS analysis reported in the Results section.

claim: The out-of-frame (OOF) rate ranged between 49 and 73% across different crispants.
source: Across the different crispants the minimal indel efficiency was 71%, while the OOF rate ranged between 49 and 73%.
evidence: This is a quantitative result from NGS analysis reported in the Results section.

claim: The accumulated percentage of reads with indels that likely cause loss-of-function of the respective protein fall within the range of 60% to 92%.
source: The accumulated percentage of reads with indels that likely cause loss-of-function of the respective protein (OOF % + % in-frame indel ≥6 bp), fall within the range of 60% to 92%, although also reads with short in-frame indels (<6 bp) can affect protein function.
evidence: This is a quantitative result from NGS analysis combining OOF and large in-frame deletions.

claim: In 20 out of the 30 examined off-target sites, no off-target mutations were identified.
source: In 20 out of the 30 examined off-target sites, no off-target mutations were identified (Supplementary file 1b).
evidence: This is a result from off-target analysis reported in the Results section.

claim: For the remaining off-target sites, the off-target rate ranged from 0.11% to 2.82%.
source: For the remaining off-target sites, the off-target rate ranged from 0,11% to 2,82%.
evidence: This is a quantitative result from off-target analysis.

claim: At 7 dpf and 14 dpf, esr1 crispants exhibited a significant increase of the osteoblasts-positive surface area within the head.
source: At 7 and 14 dpf, esr1 crispants exhibited a significant increase of the osteoblasts-positive surface area within the head (p≤0.05; p≤0.001) (Figure 1b and c).
evidence: This is a quantitative finding from osteoblast imaging analysis with statistical significance.

claim: ifitm5 crispants at 14 dpf displayed a significant increase in osteoblasts-positive surface area within the head.
source: Additionally, ifitm5 crispants at 14 dpf also displayed a significant increase (p≤0.01) in osteoblasts-positive surface area within the head.
evidence: This is a quantitative finding from osteoblast imaging analysis with statistical significance.

claim: At 7dpf, the total head exhibited a significant reduction in mineralized surface in aldh7a1 and sec24d crispants.
source: At 7dpf, the total head exhibited a significant reduction in mineralized surface in aldh7a1 (p≤0.05) and sec24d crispants (p≤0.0001), while the notochord tip displayed a significant increase in mineralized surface area in creb3l1 (p≤0.05), ifitm5 (p≤0.05), and serpinf1 (p≤0.05) crispants (Figure 1b).
evidence: This is a quantitative finding from Alizarin Red S staining analysis with statistical significance.

claim: At 7dpf, the notochord tip displayed a significant increase in mineralized surface area in creb3l1, ifitm5, and serpinf1 crispants.
source: At 7dpf, the total head exhibited a significant reduction in mineralized surface in aldh7a1 (p≤0.05) and sec24d crispants (p≤0.0001), while the notochord tip displayed a significant increase in mineralized surface area in creb3l1 (p≤0.05), ifitm5 (p≤0.05), and serpinf1 (p≤0.05) crispants (Figure 1b).
evidence: This is a quantitative finding from Alizarin Red S staining analysis with statistical significance.

claim: At 14 dpf, sec24d crispants exhibited a significant decrease in the mineralized surface area of the opercle and the number of mineralized vertebrae.
source: Finally, at 14 dpf, sec24d crispants exhibited a significant decrease (p≤0.001) in the mineralized surface area of the opercle and the number of mineralized vertebrae, whereas serpinf1 crispants showed a notable increase in the number of mineralized vertebrae (p≤0.01; Figure 1c).
evidence: This is a quantitative finding from Alizarin Red S staining analysis with statistical significance.

claim: At 14 dpf, serpinf1 crispants showed a notable increase in the number of mineralized vertebrae.
source: Finally, at 14 dpf, sec24d crispants exhibited a significant decrease (p≤0.001) in the mineralized surface area of the opercle and the number of mineralized vertebrae, whereas serpinf1 crispants showed a notable increase in the number of mineralized vertebrae (p≤0.01; Figure 1c).
evidence: This is a quantitative finding from Alizarin Red S staining analysis with statistical significance.

claim: At 7 dpf, no significant differences were seen in the expression of runx2 between the different crispants and corresponding controls.
source: At 7 dpf, no significant differences were seen in the expression of runx2, an early pre-osteoblast marker, between the different crispants and corresponding controls.
evidence: This is a result from RT-qPCR analysis at 7 dpf.

claim: Osterix (sp7) was upregulated in crispants for sparc at 7 dpf.
source: Osterix, also known as sp7, a runx2 downstream gene which plays a critical role for the differentiation of pre-osteoblasts into mature osteoblasts, was only upregulated in crispants for sparc (p≤0.001).
evidence: This is a result from RT-qPCR analysis at 7 dpf with statistical significance.

claim: Osteocalcin (bglap) was downregulated in almost all crispants at 7 dpf, except in crispants for sost and sparc.
source: Osteocalcin, also known as bglap, which is mainly expressed in mature osteoblasts, was downregulated in almost all crispants, except in crispants for sost and sparc.
evidence: This is a result from RT-qPCR analysis at 7 dpf.

claim: col1a1a was upregulated in crispants for aldh7a1, daam2, esr1 and sec24d at 7 dpf.
source: Finally, col1a1a, encoding the α1 chain of type 1 collagen, and marking extracellular matrix synthesis by both pre- and mature osteoblasts (Valenti et al., 2020), was upregulated in crispants for aldh7a1 (p≤0.001), daam2 (p≤0.05), esr1 (p≤0.05) and sec24d (p≤0.05; Figure 2a).
evidence: This is a result from RT-qPCR analysis at 7 dpf with statistical significance.

claim: At 14 dpf, the expression of runx2 remained unchanged in all crispants compared to control.
source: At 14 dpf, the expression of runx2 remained unchanged in all crispants compared to control.
evidence: This is a result from RT-qPCR analysis at 14 dpf.

claim: At 14 dpf, the expression of sp7 was significantly increased in crispants for daam2 and sec24d.
source: The expression of sp7 was significantly increased in crispants for daam2 (p≤0.05) and sec24d (p≤0.05), decreased in esr1 crispants, while expression levels were normalized in sparc crispants relative to 7 dpf (p≤0.05).
evidence: This is a result from RT-qPCR analysis at 14 dpf with statistical significance.

claim: At 14 dpf, the expression of bglap remained significantly downregulated in crispants for aldh7a1, daam2, esr1 and creb3l1.
source: The expression of bglap remained significantly downregulated in crispants for aldh7a1 (p≤0.001), daam2 (p≤0.01), esr1 (p≤0.01) and creb3l1 (p≤0.05) while it reverted to control levels in ifitm5, sec24d, and serpinf1 crispants.
evidence: This is a result from RT-qPCR analysis at 14 dpf with statistical significance.

claim: An upregulation in the expression of col1a1a was seen in all the crispants at 14 dpf, except in crispants for sparc and for aldh7a1 and esr1 where expression levels normalized compared to 7 dpf.
source: An upregulation in the expression of col1a1a was seen in all the crispants, except in crispants for sparc and for aldh7a1 and esr1 where expression levels normalized compared to 7 dpf (Figure 2b).
evidence: This is a result from RT-qPCR analysis at 14 dpf.

claim: Crispants for both aldh7a1 and mbtps2 displayed early lethality.
source: Crispants for both aldh7a1 and mbtps2 displayed early lethality.
evidence: This is an observation from survival analysis of adult crispants.

claim: aldh7a1 crispants experienced increased lethality from 7 dpf onwards, with no survivors beyond 20 dpf.
source: Survival analysis indicated that aldh7a1 crispants experienced increased lethality from 7 dpf onwards, with no survivors beyond 20 dpf, while mbtps2 crispants exhibited increased lethality from 17 dpf onwards, with only a very small number of fish surviving into adulthood (90 dpf; Figure 3).
evidence: This is a result from survival analysis with reference to Figure 3.

claim: mbtps2 crispants exhibited increased lethality from 17 dpf onwards, with only a very small number of fish surviving into adulthood (90 dpf).
source: Survival analysis indicated that aldh7a1 crispants experienced increased lethality from 7 dpf onwards, with no survivors beyond 20 dpf, while mbtps2 crispants exhibited increased lethality from 17 dpf onwards, with only a very small number of fish surviving into adulthood (90 dpf; Figure 3).
evidence: This is a result from survival analysis with reference to Figure 3.

claim: ARS staining of the skeleton of two surviving adult mbtps2 crispant fish revealed severe cranial malformations, including underdevelopment of the premaxilla, dentary, and articular.
source: ARS staining of the skeleton of two surviving adult mbtps2 crispant fish revealed severe cranial malformations, including underdevelopment of the premaxilla, dentary, and articular.
evidence: This is an observation from ARS staining of adult mbtps2 crispants.

claim: Among the eight crispants that successfully matured into adulthood, none exhibited significant differences in standard length and head size.
source: Among the eight crispants that successfully matured into adulthood, none exhibited significant differences in standard length and head size (n=5 fish per crispant; Figure 4b).
evidence: This is a quantitative result from morphometric analysis of adult crispants.

claim: esr1 crispants were observed to have notably larger eye diameters.
source: However, esr1 crispants were observed to have notably larger eye diameters (Figure 4b).
evidence: This is a quantitative result from morphometric analysis of adult crispants.

claim: All adult crispants demonstrated various abnormalities in the caudal part of the vertebral column such as fusions, compressions, fractures, or arch malformations, except for daam2 crispants where no obvious abnormalities were detected.
source: All these crispants demonstrated various abnormalities in the caudal part of the vertebral column such as fusions, compressions, fractures, or arch malformations, except for daam2 crispants where no obvious abnormalities were detected (Figure 4a and c; Figure 4—figure supplement 1).
evidence: This is an observation from ARS staining and imaging of adult crispants.

claim: In creb3l1 crispants, the vertebral phenotype was relatively mild and primarily restricted to arch malformations.
source: In creb3l1 crispants, the vertebral phenotype was relatively mild and primarily restricted to arch malformations.
evidence: This is an observation from ARS staining and imaging of adult crispants.

claim: A significant increase in centrum volume was observed in daam2 crispants compared to the controls.
source: A significant increase in centrum volume was observed in daam2 crispants compared to the controls (p<0.05, z=2.86; Figure 4d).
evidence: This is a quantitative result from microCT analysis with statistical significance.

claim: Centrum TMD was significantly higher in crispants for daam2, esr1, and sost.
source: Centrum TMD was significantly higher, and to a similar extent, in crispants for daam2 (p<0.05; z=1.54), esr1 (p<0.05; z=1.62), and sost (p<0.05; z=1.41), three genes likely involved in osteoporosis pathogenesis.
evidence: This is a quantitative result from microCT analysis with statistical significance.

claim: Centrum thickness was increased in crispants for esr1, ifitm5, and sec24d with the most pronounced increase observed in ifitm5 crispants.
source: Centrum thickness was increased in crispants for esr1 (p<0.05; z=4.26), ifitm5 (p<0.01; z=7.13), and sec24d (p<0.05; z=5.04) with the most pronounced increase observed in ifitm5 crispants.
evidence: This is a quantitative result from microCT analysis with statistical significance.

claim: Centrum length was increased only in daam2 crispants.
source: Centrum length was increased only in daam2 crispants (p<0.05; z=4.22).
evidence: This is a quantitative result from microCT analysis with statistical significance.

claim: The depletion of estrogen in an osteoblastic cell line in vitro results in the stimulation of osteoblast differentiation.
source: However, the depletion of estrogen in an osteoblastic cell line in vitro results in the stimulation of osteoblast differentiation (Schiavi et al., 2021).
evidence: This is a cited finding from Schiavi et al., 2021.

claim: Disrupted sec24d function leads to head abnormalities and growth delays in early larval stages in bulldog zebrafish.
source: These findings aligned with the observed malformations in bulldog zebrafish, where disrupted sec24d function leads to head abnormalities and growth delays in early larval stages (Sarmah et al., 2010).
evidence: This is a cited finding from Sarmah et al., 2010.

claim: Mature osteoblasts engage in the deposition of calcium and phosphate ions, essential for the formation of hydroxyapatite crystals.
source: As mainly mature osteoblasts engage in the deposition of calcium and phosphate ions, essential for the formation of hydroxyapatite crystals, bone mineralization can be expected to be reduced in the crispants, which results in increased formation of non-mineralized osteoid deposits.
evidence: This is a statement based on established knowledge of osteoblast function.

claim: Knock-out mice lacking Sost showed an increase in TMD within the cortical bone.
source: Knock-out mice lacking Sost showed an increase in TMD within the cortical bone, which is comparable to the bone present in the zebrafish vertebral column (Li et al., 2008).
evidence: This is a cited finding from Li et al., 2008.

claim: Mutant mice with a hypomorphic Daam2 allele presented with reduced bone strength and increased cortical bone porosity.
source: As for the other genes, for daam2, mutant mice with a hypomorphic Daam2 allele presented with reduced bone strength and increased cortical bone porosity (Morris et al., 2019).
evidence: This is a cited finding from Morris et al., 2019.

claim: ERα knockout mice presented with a decrease in cortical bone mineral density and increase in trabecular bone mineral density.
source: ERα knockout mice presented with a decrease in cortical bone mineral density and increase in trabecular bone mineral density (Melville et al., 2014).
evidence: This is a cited finding from Melville et al., 2014.

claim: Genetic compensation can be triggered by the upregulation of compensating genes, often mediated through the regulation of nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) in combination with the epigenetic machinery in zebrafish.
source: This compensation mechanism can be triggered by the upregulation of compensating genes, often mediated through the regulation of nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) in combination with the epigenetic machinery in zebrafish (El-Brolosy and Stainier, 2017; Jakutis and Stainier, 2021).
evidence: This is a cited statement about genetic compensation mechanisms in zebrafish.

claim: Crispants undergo nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) although in a mosaic manner.
source: Crispants, in contrast to morphants, also undergo NMD although in a mosaic manner.
evidence: This is a statement about the molecular mechanisms in crispants.

claim: The skeletal malformations in crispants were consistently observed in a second clutch, underscoring the reproducibility of these phenotypic features across independent clutches.
source: Additionally, these skeletal malformations were consistently observed in a second clutch of crispants (Figure 4—figure supplement 3), underscoring the reproducibility of these phenotypic features across independent clutches.
evidence: This is a statement about reproducibility with reference to Figure 4—figure supplement 3.

claim: All studied crispants exhibit skeletal abnormalities in adult stages.
source: Nonetheless, our initial set-up demonstrates the feasibility of this approach to identify genes potentially implicated in the pathogenesis of skeletal disorders, as all studied crispants exhibit skeletal abnormalities in adult stages.
evidence: This is a summary statement of the findings across all crispants.

claim: The osx:Kaede transgenic line was used for all experiments.
source: The osx:Kaede transgenic line was used for all experiments.
evidence: This is a methodological detail from the Materials and methods section.

claim: Two-part guide RNAs (gRNAs) are functional gRNA duplexes made of a universal 67 mer trans-activating CRISPR-RNA (tracrRNA) and a target-specific CRISPR-RNA (crRNA).
source: In summary, two-part guide RNAs (gRNAs) were used which are functional gRNA duplexes made of a universal 67 mer trans-activating CRISPR-RNA (tracrRNA) and a target-specific CRISPR-RNA (crRNA) (Alt-R CRISPR-Cas9 System, IDT).
evidence: This is a methodological detail about the CRISPR system used.

claim: A non-specific crRNA (GCAGGCAAAGAATCCCTGCC), referred to as the 'scrambled' sequence, was used to generate the controls.
source: A non-specific crRNA (GCAGGCAAAGAATCCCTGCC), referred to as the 'scrambled' sequence, was used to generate the controls (Wu et al., 2018).
evidence: This is a methodological detail about the control generation.

claim: The injection mix consisted of a 1.4 nL drop containing RNase-free water, KCl (2000 mM) and ribonucleoproteins (RNPs), consisting of 800 pg of both gRNA duplex and Cas9 (1000 ng/µl) protein.
source: The injection mix consisted of a 1.4 nL drop containing RNase-free water, KCl (2000 mM) and ribonucleoproteins (RNPs), consisting of 800 pg of both gRNA duplex and Cas9 (1000 ng/µl) (ToolGen, Seoul, South Korea; wild-type nuclease with nuclear localization signal) protein.
evidence: This is a methodological detail about the injection protocol.

claim: For each crispant and each corresponding control, a total of 200 eggs, originating from the same clutch, were injected.
source: For each crispant and each corresponding control, a total of 200 eggs, originating from the same clutch, were injected.
evidence: This is a methodological detail about the experimental design.

claim: DNA was extracted from 10 pooled embryos at one day after fertilization for NGS analysis.
source: We extracted DNA from 10 pooled embryos at one day after fertilization by adding 100 µl NaOH and incubating the samples at 95 °C for 20 min.
evidence: This is a methodological detail about DNA extraction for NGS.

claim: For each crispant, RNA was extracted from 4 or 5 pools of 10 embryos at 7 dpf and 14 dpf.
source: The RNA extraction and qPCR protocol described by Bek et al., 2020 was followed, with minor modifications; for each crispant, RNA was extracted from 4 or 5 pools of 10 embryos at 7 dpf and 14 dpf using Trizol (Life Technologies Europe) and purified using the RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen) with on-column DNase I treatment (Qiagen).
evidence: This is a methodological detail about RNA extraction for RT-qPCR.

claim: Ten zebrafish larvae with the transgenic osx:Kaede background were used for osteoblast imaging at 7 dpf and 14 dpf.
source: Ten zebrafish larvae (at 7 dpf and 14 dpf) with the transgenic osx:Kaede background were anesthetized using 1 x Tricaine.
evidence: This is a methodological detail about the sample size for osteoblast imaging.

claim: Images of 7 dpf larvae were taken from the ventral side for osteoblast imaging.
source: Images of 7 dpf larvae were taken from the ventral side.
evidence: This is a methodological detail about imaging orientation.

claim: Images of 14 dpf larvae were taken from both ventral and lateral perspectives for osteoblast imaging.
source: Images of 14 dpf larvae were taken from both ventral and lateral perspectives to provide a more comprehensive view of the opercle's surface area.
evidence: This is a methodological detail about imaging orientation.

claim: All measurements for osteoblast-positive area were performed in triplicate on blinded pictures.
source: All measurements were performed in triplicate on blinded pictures.
evidence: This is a methodological detail about measurement protocol.

claim: Mann-Whitney U test was applied in GraphPad Prism (v.9.4.0), with p-values considered significant when ≤0.05.
source: Mann-Whitney U test was applied in GraphPad Prism (v.9.4.0), with p-values considered significant when ≤0.05.
evidence: This is a methodological detail about statistical analysis.

claim: Adult zebrafish (3 months post fertilization) were euthanized using a 25 x tricaine solution for microCT analysis.
source: Adult zebrafish (3 months post fertilization) were euthanized using a 25 x tricaine solution (4000 mg tricaine powder (Sigma), 979 ml distilled water, and 1 M Tris, adjusted to pH 7).
evidence: This is a methodological detail about sample preparation for microCT.

claim: The fish were fixed for approximately one week in a fixative solution (4% paraformaldehyde, 5% triton X-100, and 1% potassium hydroxide) before microCT scanning.
source: The fish were fixed for approximately one week in a fixative solution (4% paraformaldehyde, 5% triton X-100, and 1% potassium hydroxide).
evidence: This is a methodological detail about sample preparation for microCT.

claim: A voxel size of 20³ µm³ was obtained for microCT scanning using geometrical magnification.
source: Using geometrical magnification, a voxel size of 20³ µm³ was obtained (Masschaele et al., 2013).
evidence: This is a methodological detail about microCT scanning parameters.
